summary: Phase 3 complete. Applied conservative sorting to all 3049 CNS questions using apply-sorting-v3.py. Two-pass strategy: (1) moves questions from unauthorized subjects to authorized ones via TF-IDF/classifier mapping, (2) structural-term override for 43 questions about core anatomical structures (cerebellum, basal ganglia, pons, thalamus, etc.) whose primary text contains the structure. Output validated: all 10 chapters contain only authorized subjects, all 3049 questions accounted for, schema validation passed.
